answer_1.quote: we perform the first comprehensive analysis of the effects that grounding objectives have on LVLM object hallucination in open (i.e., free-form) image captioning ... We evaluate on MSCOCO and Objects365 datasets.
answer_1.outputs: free-form image captions (and grounded captions with interleaved bounding boxes)

answer_2.quote: We add the following two standard metrics to monitor how grounding objectives affect the general caption quality: CIDEr ... CLIP-Score ... We focus on two popular metrics for quantifying hallucination in open caption generation: CHAIR and FaithScore ... POPE accuracy is used for QA‑based evaluation.

answer_3.quote: FaithScore computation is a 2‑stage process that relies: (1) on an LLM to extract 'atomic facts' from the generated text, phrasing them as statements ... The original work relies on GPT-4 to extract facts but this is too expensive for our evaluation; instead, we use a smaller LLM after verifying that it successfully follows task instructions.
